transform_points: transform 3D points using a 4x4 transformation matrix with homogeneous coordinate normalization
read_mesh_vertices: read vertex coordinates from a PLY mesh file and return them as a numpy array
export_instance_ids_for_eval: export 3D instance labels and per-instance mask files for instance segmentation evaluation
read_instance_prediction_file: parse an instance prediction text file into a dictionary mapping mask files to label and confidence info
get_instances: extract instance objects from label and instance ID arrays grouped by class label
